notes:
POC status: stalled. Background: Orion Civic Labs (city services platform used by several municipal clients) engaged Redwood for a citizen-facing chat assistant and internal doc search across municipal code and permit docs. POC started in Nov 2025; goal was validate latency (p50 ~150ms), quality on local docs, and exportable audit logs for compliance. SE spun up dedicated test nodes in customer VPC and tested Llama-family 33B/70B variants with quantization to meet cost targets.

What went wrong: the internal champion (Dir Digital Services) left unexpectedly in Jan; subsequent headcount/budget freeze paused any engineering work. InfoSec put additional blockers on KMS/HSM proof and required an on-prem option for full production. Procurement has initiated parallel eval with Anthropic via a cloud partner — price + managed SLA is attractive to them.

Customer quotes / paraphrase: "We like the runbook and the latency numbers but we can't promise cycles until hiring completes." / "InfoSec won't sign off without HSM integration proof and residency guarantees."

Sales posture: account moved to stalled-waiting. We proposed a 30-day reduced-scope pilot limited to search-only (smaller model, fewer tokens) and a security deep-dive with our infra security lead. Offered to produce a small HSM integration demo (redacted) and an EU-residency runbook. No uptake.

Action items logged: keep quarterly check-in cadence; pursue re-intro when city budget review completes (target FY26 Q3). If procurement re-opens, position Dedicated or Private with HSM add-on.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive), security FAQ (drive), fireflies transcripts. Jira INF-8423: missing trace id on POC logs; INF-8710: security checklist follow-up.
sales_play_notes: Stalled POC: typical public-sector pattern — champion churn + hiring freeze. Treat as long lead. High chance to re-open in Q3 once budget cycles move. Recommended next step: exec re-intro + one pager showing gap vs Anthropic on SLOs + cost. Offer timeboxed compliance proof (HSM demo) as unblocker.
